ns0:media.alt: Figure shows three graphs. In the first, the lines intersect at point 3, minus 1. The intersecting lines have one point in common. There is one solution to the system. In the second graph, the lines are parallel. Parallel lines have no points in common. There is no solution to the system. The third graph has only one line. Here, both equations give the same line. Because we have only one line, there are infinite many solutions.
